mprViewSync.Description: Synchronize display coordinates of open views
mprViewSync.h4: When activated, the view will be selected as the source view for synchronization. The next activated view will be synchronized by the source view, and then will be selected as the source view for synchronization
mprViewSync.h8: When activated, view crop settings will be synchronized
mprViewSync.h9: When activated, 3D view bounds will be synchronized
